title: Rework Comeback Days, Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Clause.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, rework comeback days are added to the rework courtesy rental days on a covered network rework. The rework comeback days follow the remedy attempts on the coverage completed with the concern not resolved, network reworks and outside-shop repairs alike: two or more, the two-failure comeback days, 2 days; exactly one, the one-failure comeback days, 1 day; none, no rework comeback days.

| Completions on the coverage with the concern not resolved | Rework comeback days |
|---|---|
| none | none |
| exactly one | 1 day |
| two or more | 2 days |

## Scope of the count

Every remedy attempt on the coverage whose completion recorded the concern as not resolved counts, whether it was a network rework or an outside-shop repair and whichever concern it was for. Completions recorded as resolved do not count.

## Hypothetical cases

- One earlier network rework on the same concern ended not resolved: 1 day is added.
- An outside-shop repair ended not resolved and a later network rework also ended not resolved: 2 days are added.
- Every completion on the coverage ended resolved: no comeback days.
